summary: Full backend + frontend regression for PaperCut v2 (bulk queue, smart meta, crop adjust, memo pairing). 18/18 pytest cases pass against the live preview API in 72s (includes 3 real AI job runs). Frontend Playwright verifies: bulk file picker + 'Queue N PDFs' CTA, bulk-upload-progress bar, queue-counts tiles updating live as jobs move queued->running->done, queue-filter-* tabs, history item open, job-meta-bar + edit-meta-dialog, memo-status (5/5 matched shown), question-card lightbox with lightbox-tab-question / lightbox-tab-partner / lightbox-tab-adjust, crop-handle-top-0 + crop-handle-bottom-0 + crop-save-button + crop-add-page-button rendered, question-label-input + save, merge-next and delete buttons. Jobs are processed sequentially by the single worker as expected. No critical bugs.

issues: Radix warns in console: 'Missing Description or aria-describedby for DialogContent'. Add <DialogDescription> (or aria-describedby=undefined) for a11y.

action_items: (Low) Add DialogDescription to MetaEditor and QuestionDialog to silence Radix a11y warning.
(Low, carry-over from iter 1) _storage_call now DOES retry on 5xx (verified in core.py line 50-52) — iteration_1 action item is already addressed.
critical_code_review_comments: jobs.py `try_pair` matches on exact case-insensitive subject/grade/year/session/paper. If AI returns e.g. 'Nov' vs 'November' for the same pair, auto-match fails. Consider normalising session via SESSION_ABBR before matching.

routes.py PATCH /jobs/{id}/meta: `type_changed or not job.paired_job_id` — the `not paired_job_id` branch means every meta edit on an unpaired job calls unpair()+try_pair(). Fine, but if user is just fixing a typo in `language` or `paper` an auto-pair might attach the wrong partner. Low risk.
merge_next in routes.py uses `p.y0 <= parts[-1].y1 + 30` to decide if two parts touch — magic number, document it.
process_job loads entire PDF + all page JPEGs (b64) in memory. For 20+ page papers RAM pressure will grow linearly; worth streaming or chunking later.
worker_loop sleeps 2s when queue empty — acceptable but no graceful shutdown handling; on SIGTERM an in-flight job will be marked error by startup migration on next boot (iter 1 noted this).
